notes.title: House Flipper: VR – Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello there, VR Flippers! 

It's Christmas time! Although this is the time when you suppose to rest and spend some time with your family, we are working hard to make your VR experience as pleasant as possible. The recent update has brought some Christmas-themed items and a new house, so you can spend your free time decorating it, and we hope you've loved the changes we've made so far. Curious what we are bringing to you this time? Without further ado, let's get the Christmas rolling!

As you already know, Christmas is all about the snowy environment, when you spend the whole day making a snowman or on snowball fights together with your relatives or your friends. Although you can't do that in House Flipper: VR, we did our best to create the Christmas environment as friendly as possible. Check it out below: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/7099bae95c33c8872f76c71766545c2545252a34.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/3835cbe4aa0ab93b6f3f8c7b6fdd367c914ade67.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/a61dc2b73f914d85cbe7297ae9272616ec3d7b11.png

But that is not the end – we've also managed to put some emphasis on the tablet. Now, it is more pleasant to work on it since it is bigger, but if there is no place to pop it out, the smaller one will spawn, so there is nothing to worry about. We've also improved putting up furniture. Now it is a bit easier to place them in the right place. 

Last but not least, we would like to remind you that now you can grab House Flipper VR with a 50% discount on Steam. So, if you are still looking for a gift, or simply you would like to spend some time decorating houses in virtual reality, do not hesitate, and grab yourself a copy. 

[Here is the link to the discount]

We wish you a Merry Christmas and a happy flipping!

~Frozen Way Team

notes.title: HF: VR Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey there, VR Flippers!

It has already been 3 weeks since the release of the Panel Tool update, and we are glad to see you’ve enjoyed the changes we introduced: the main one being the new tool, which allowed you to completely change the appearance of the walls. In addition to that, we’ve also introduced the new tool selection menu, which makes choosing the devices a breeze.

We thought it is time to show you what we have in the works for the game: a new content update!

This time, we’ve focused on musical items, like guitars, but also a fully interactable drum kit, and a xylophone too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/f7138148fe131e3bc26cec24547014b4441b717f.png

The update will also come with things like acoustic wall panels, so you can create the recording studio of your dreams.

While we do not yet have a release date in mind, we will hopefully be able to inform you about that soon.

What type of content would you like to see in future updates? Let us know in the comment section below, and we might add your ideas to the list of upcoming items!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/6b403f1cde87023faee6b103e837e63d1d302961.gif

Happy Flipping!
~Frozen Way Team

notes.title: Panel Tool Update
notes.notes:
Panel Tool Update is here!

Hey there, VR flippers!

We are happy to announce that the panel tool update is finally out!

Panel Tool will allow you to place panels on the walls of your houses, expanding your options to change the appearance of the rooms, and create something truly unique!
The panels are available in the shop, in their own category - the only thing you need to do is buy them and insert them into the new tool.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/ba4c8f4ba399ee83683518516a88b42b2366277f.gif


Once inserted, point at the spot on the wall you’d like to apply the panel to, and press the trigger.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/7d6b8999fef1024a8d164aa5c57b942a621f126b.gif


In order to unlock the new tool, you must pick it up during the Moving in quest. If you have already finished this quest, you will already have access to the Panel Tool.

In addition to the new tool, we’ve added a convenient menu for the tools - it’s a new way of choosing the desired tool quickly and comfortably by pointing at the appropriate icon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/afee3889a00e10dcbac8dd13c0cfc92569ea2d4c.gif


The new additions will give you more possibilities, as well as make your flipping adventures more convenient.

On the final note, make sure to check out our new project that is currently in the development phase called Honeycomb!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb/

We hope you’ll enjoy the new features! 

Happy flipping!
~Frozen Way Team

notes.title: PATCH 1.2 arrives today - Texture and movement tweaks!
notes.notes:
Hey there Virtual Flippers!

It's time for another update for House Flipper VR. What's on the menu this time you ask?

Well... first and foremost, influenced by tons of feedback from our community, we made a couple of significant changes in the control system and reworked the tutorial section of the game to give the new players a better understanding of the controls and mechanics.

We also promised to bring you constant content updates, so this time we're adding lots of new colour / material variants. Anyway, without further ado, let's jump into details:



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/886148f7466b13f5106e890f60f0f1082c7564a0.png

:shard_blue: You can now freely move while holding items - hooray!

:shard_blue: The tutorial has been refreshed and expanded to give you a good grasp of the basic mechanics.

:shard_blue: The trash picker reached its final form and is now even longer - no more back pain!

:shard_blue: Texture upgrade - a new approach to their appearance!

:shard_blue: Colour variants have been improved as well!

:shard_blue: We managed to fix the bug that caused some trash to be invincible.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/57b26e5e7b35c773c9fe080030fe3efb8ca6edfc.png
"Being able to freely move with items in hand has been one of the most requested features since we released the game, and we felt like it indeed makes a lot of sense. To make it happen, we had to tweak the controls here and there, but finally, we were able to deliver this feature to our players."


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/101b31ab4b6ecd69aa9f165cd3a842201ada63eb.png
"We also heard that some players are having problems with the trash picker being too short, so we've decided to increase the reach even more (yep, we've already made it longer in the past)."


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/a62d3a70b055f86680f60312e601c44c8a000d5a.png
"We've also decided to turn up the variety of the items and implemented new material and colour variants. We totally reworked the kitchen furniture when it comes to textures and made some changes which contribute towards a realistic appearance and a consistent style of the items! We hope you'll enjoy them!"



"Last but not least, we have a little sneak peek for ya! In the next update, we're about to bring you a bunch of new items, focusing on certain styles and themes:"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/99a041335a0464791a8991d3d89be35cde36c2e8.png

"Stay tuned!"

notes.title: Controls update - enjoy Vive Cosmos support and many more!
notes.notes:
Hey there Virtual Flippers!
It is time for our first post-release update.
This time we gathered all the feedback we had during the first couple of days after the launch, and worked hard to bring you some more support and control adjustments. This is still not everything we're about to improve in the nearest future, but for now, we're happy with the results.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/ffbfec47763d5e5519dd39957ad5986ba394b42b.png

So here's what the following update brings you:

- Full Vive COSMOS Support

- Valve Index more intuitive gripping and rotating with the stick

- HTC Vive and Vive Cosmos Elite controls fix

- new item put down physics - items no longer go back to the start position when colliding on put down

- item rotation snap fix

- new 45 snap angle

- Teleporting on carpets available

- Easy and intuitive UI button clicking

- Paintcan not being able to be placed in PaintTool after selling fix

notes.title: New update + known issues!
notes.notes:
Hey there Virtual Flippers!

Yesterday was a big day, not just because of the release and the celebration stream, but also because you gave us lots of initial feedback!
We always say that we're trying to develop our games with the help of our communities, so we cannot thank you enough!



Anyway, let's get to the important stuff!

Here's a couple of answers to the most popular questions / reported issues we've seen on our Community Hub:

- We're getting ready to introduce full HTC Vive Cosmos support. It should arrive on Monday - Nov 9.

- If you're having issues with Valve Index, try setting the refresh rate to 80! (SteamVR->settings->refresh rate)

- We've also added the longer brush you've seen on stream. No more back pain!

- There were some issues with the classic vive controllers, but they should work much better now! Try it out and let us know!

- If you're having any issues with smooth locomotion, try switching to "one-handed locomotion" that has been developed by us specifically for HF:VR. Should work much smoother once you get used to it.

- Sometimes you might experience an issue with no in-game sound. Try restarting your game (or in the worst case scenario - your PC).



Next week we're also going to focus on our first post-launch content update that's going to arrive as soon as possible!

Once again, thank you for your honest feedback, and have an amazing weekend! 😃

notes.title: House Flipper VR release postponed! November 5!
notes.notes:
Big news! 🙀

After receiving more feedback from our community, we've got a couple of new ideas on how to improve the gameplay of House Flipper VR!

That's why we decided to postpone the release while we're still working on additional functionalities and last polishes.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/d691d10cb90ee72e6ac179d515f21f3ebcd111c4.png

"We really want to avoid rushing the project and releasing a game that we wouldn't be 100% happy with, that's why we're giving it 2 more weeks!
We feel that having a little bit of extra time will give us more of a comfortable finish in the development process."



Soon we might throw in a little extra devlog to show you what exactly we're working on during these additional 2 weeks.

Stay tuned and join us during a developer stream on the release day - 5th of November! (more info on that will also come soon!)

notes.title: Devlog #4! The last pre-release House Flipper VR Devlog!
notes.notes:
Hey there Flippers!
Another week of development, closer and closer to the release!
Make sure to add House Flipper VR to your wishlist to get reminded when it comes out this month! (October 22nd)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1194700/House_Flipper_VR/


So what we've been up to?

Well, first of all, we've started taking good care of the appraiser system.
At the moment we're working hard to add more of them to the game, and give each one a unique personality and his or her very own taste of style.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/4e0dd3831da65cedbeb6fd2ce1f0b6e47e1b47a6.gif

You can roughly figure out the interior design preferences of the appraisers through their posters.
We also made sure to throw in a bit of realism, as after a successful purchase, the buyer will not be included in the next auction.
Every appraiser also has his personal favorite in terms of properties, and they will buy it without much hesitation, so make sure to figure out their likings!


After all, we've also worked on the graphics a little bit!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/98942c664ea3874ee5c5cc4a782588a62c62b5cd.gif

You can now choose between 6 graphic options: Low, Medium, Normal, High, Very High and Ultra.
Above you can see the comparison between the lowest and the highest setting.


Last but not least there's the environment!
Now you can feel the good vibes in a calm neighborhood... definitely boosts the immersion!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36699114/2e788d1028886d905365accf5e22fe6e755c5a2c.png

That's all for now, October is surely going to be a big month as we're getting very close to the release which is planned on the 22nd.



Stay tuned and thank you for your support!
